notes_on_misses: The reviewed internal-API load chain (src-045 api/routes.py:977 request.args.get('path') -> load :981 -> GPI load -> getScriptPath -> open Persistency:190, sink-495 tp 0.90) produced NO Pass 1 alert. The label set predicted it; the analysis did not emit it. Likely cause: the dual-anchored getScriptPath/load bridge edges (sink-494/sink-396) did not connect the interprocedural flow at analysis time. Recorded as a chain-level coverage gap, not a false positive in the emitted set.

src-070 (FileStorage object, gui:941) and src-072 (filename attribute, gui:953) produced no standalone alerts, exactly as predicted (no object->path taint by default; src-072 cut by the secure_filename barrier).

allowed_roots.job_browse: Implied root: the job base directory job_base_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(job_info['outputdir'])) (gui/routes.py:651), derived from repository content of an integer-selected job. NOT enforced anywhere.
allowed_roots.storage_page: Declared root: STORAGE_FOLDER = gangadir/gui/storage (gui/config.py:35, GangaGUI/gui/routes.py:931). NOT enforced anywhere.
allowed_roots.internal_export: No root at all: fullpath() (Persistency:140-151) = abspath(expandvars(expanduser(filename))) - normalization without confinement; the operator CLI usage of the same GPI function is by design 'write anywhere', but the web boundary exposes it unauthenticated.

containment_and_barriers.barrier: secure_filename(storagefile.filename) at gui/routes.py:953 (werkzeug): strips path separators, '..' and absolute-name components from the uploaded FILENAME only. Partial by design - the DIRECTORY component (abs_path from the tainted route path via join :934/:954 arg 0) never passes through it, so the storage write traversal is unblocked.
containment_and_barriers.no_containment_anywhere: On all four confirmed chains there is no resolve/realpath + containment check, no startswith(base) prefix test, no relative_to, no '..' segment rejection, no basename extraction, no chroot, before any file access. Verified by reading gui/routes.py:639-689 and :925-992 and Persistency/__init__.py:35-90 in full.
containment_and_barriers.rejected_as_barriers: os.path.join (value-preserving concatenation, '..' survives lexically, absolute arg replaces base), fullpath/abspath (collapses '..' but confines to nothing - correctly modeled as propagation), getScriptPath exists-branch (returns the expanded attacker name verbatim, Runtime.py:47-49), @login_required (authenticates the user, never constrains the path value), allowed_file extension allowlist (gui/routes.py:1799, applies only to the fixed-path loadfile/runfile channels).

decode_and_canonicalization.decoding: Flask/Werkzeug percent-decodes the request path exactly once in the router (external to the DB); request.args values form-decoded once. No application-level re-decoding exists anywhere on the chains, so double-decode concerns do not apply.
decode_and_canonicalization.canonicalization_order: On the GUI chains, normalization happens only at OS syscall time (exists/isfile/isdir/send_file/listdir/save) - i.e. never before access, which is the defect. On the export chain abspath runs before open but performs no confinement.
decode_and_canonicalization.traversal_vectors: Both lexical '..' segments (survive os.path.join, resolve at syscall) and absolute-path replacement (os.path.join discards the base when an argument is absolute, matching the reported PoC curl --path-as-is '/job/<id>/browse///../../../../etc/passwd') are live. Windows drive/UNC forms are not applicable to the deployed POSIX server but the absolute-path form is the equivalent.

mix_in_check.evidence: The SARIF contains a single run, a single rule (py/augur/ganga/pass1-path-traversal), and 11 results all carrying that ruleId. iris/diagnostics/ is empty (no diagnostic queries created). The 11 result locations all coincide with the reviewed tp sink labels (sink-780/781/782/783/798/801/803/804/805/806/492). No CodeQL built-in security query results are present.

source.reason: Query-string parameter of GET /internal/jobs/<int:job_id>/export (route registered at api/routes.py:212). The internal Flask app has NO authentication on any route (no @login_required, no before_request/token hook anywhere in api/routes.py - verified by grep) and is bound to 'localhost' via APIServerThread("GangaGUIAPI", "localhost", port) (GangaGUI/start.py:99/:109). The whole value is attacker-supplied.

sink.operation: builtin open(filepath, mode) with mode 'w'/'a' followed by writelines/write of ganga object dumps
sink.access_type: arbitrary file WRITE (content partly attacker-influenced: object dump of an integer-selected job, plus fixed '#Ganga#' headers)

taint_flow: GPI bridge summary edge (sink-490): call arg -> Persistency export param filename (:35); required because GangaCore.GPI is runtime-populated via exportToInterface (bootstrap.py:147-163), so static import resolution fails
Persistency/__init__.py:35-36 export -> stripped_export(stripProxy(item), filename, mode) arg 1
alerts.allowed_root: None. fullpath() turns any relative/absolute/'..'-laden or ~-bearing value into an absolute path but never confines it to a base directory.
alerts.validation_evidence: None between source and sink: no path validation, no root containment, no auth. The only early-outs are empty-filename and invalid-mode checks (:66, :76) which do not constrain the path value.
preconditions: Reachability of the internal API port: the app binds 'localhost' (start.py:99/:109). Remote exploitation requires (a) a local process, (b) a cross-origin GET from a victim browser (the GET executes server-side and the write occurs even though SOP blocks reading the response), or (c) SSRF/forwarding from a co-located component. The GUI's own job-export view only ever passes a fixed UPLOAD_FOLDER/export.txt path (gui/routes.py:617-621); arbitrary paths require direct internal-port access.
A valid job_id must exist so jobs(job_id) resolves and export() is actually entered.
alerts.reasoning: Source is a genuine unauthenticated request field; the codeFlow reproduces every hop with real source evidence (the two GPI bridge edges are anchored to the exact reviewed call sites and are justified by the runtime-populated GPI namespace, not fabricated); the sink is a real builtin open in write/append mode, not a mere path construction. expandvars/expanduser additionally let '~' and '$VAR' forms resolve server-side. This is a real arbitrary-file-write path traversal (CWE-22/36) whose severity is bounded by the localhost binding and the fixed-ish write content - hence primary TP with slightly reduced confidence. Not a normal-authorization case: the web boundary adds zero checks over the operator CLI usage of the same function.

Low standalone impact and it also fires on ordinary (non-traversal) browse requests, so it is a secondary/low-severity TP rather than an FP: the tainted value and missing containment are real, and the alert is superseded by the primary :671/:676 alerts on the same defect.

taint_flow: gui/routes.py:639 route param path (path converter, one percent-decode in router)

alerts.validation_evidence: No canonicalization, no containment, no '..' rejection, no whitelist anywhere between :639 and :671. send_file is imported from flask (gui/routes.py:15). The only gates are existence/type stats on the same tainted path.
preconditions: Authenticated GUI session (default admin account GangaGUIAdmin with random 7-char password, start.py:162 - weak-entropy credential on a long-running server).
Target path must exist and be a file, readable by the GUI process.
alerts.reasoning: This is the textbook absolute/relative path traversal: uncontained route path -> os.path.join -> send_file. The DB source at 0c0f9e33 contains the pre-fix code (os.path.join at :659, send_file at :671), exactly the code changed by the reference fix (os.path.join -> werkzeug safe_join). The PoC 'curl --path-as-is /job/<id>/browse///../../../../etc/passwd' is reproduced by the modeled join semantics. Login is not a path barrier. HIGH confidence TP; this is also the ground-truth vulnerability for this dataset instance (see ground_truth section).

gui/routes.py:953 filename = secure_filename(storagefile.filename)  [filename component sanitized - barrier]

alerts.allowed_root: Declared root gangadir/gui/storage. Not enforced for the directory component.
alerts.validation_evidence: The one real barrier in the tree - secure_filename (:953, werkzeug, imported gui/routes.py:14) - strips separators/'..'/absolute components from the FILENAME only. The DIRECTORY component abs_path never passes through it, so POST /storage/<traversal>/ with any multipart file writes outside the storage root. The rejected allowed_file extension allowlist (:1799) is not applied on this channel.
preconditions: Write constrained by: filename component must survive secure_filename (leading dots and separators stripped, so dotfile/extension-forming is limited) and by process write permissions.
alerts.reasoning: Directory-component traversal to a write sink with fully attacker-controlled content: a real CWE-22 arbitrary file write, distinct from and complementary to the read chains. The barrier analysis is correct in the run notes: secure_filename is partial by design and cannot suppress this flow. HIGH-confidence TP.

hit_by.note: PRIMARY hit - the exact sink named in the vulnerability report. Source = route path param (:639), propagation = the unchecked os.path.join (:659) whose absolute-argument replacement semantics are precisely the root cause described in the commit. Both PoC variants ('..' chain and absolute path) are covered by the modeled join semantics.
same function/chain - directory-listing variant of the same defect
same chain - branch selector feeding the send_file read

ground_truth_hit_analysis.conclusion: The real vulnerability (absolute/relative path traversal in job_browse via os.path.join -> send_file) IS hit by the official Pass 1 result set: alert index 3 is a line-exact, sink-exact match to the fixed sink, on the pre-fix source revision, with a complete source->join->sink codeFlow. Three further alerts (indexes 1, 2, 4) are co-located variants of the same defect. The Pass 1 run additionally surfaced three independent true-positive chains not named in that commit (storage read :975/:980, storage write :955, internal-API export write Persistency:85).

independence_statement.ground_truth_consulted: Only the vulnerability record supplied verbatim in this task's prompt (commit 730e7ab text) was used for the hit-analysis section. No PyVul ground-truth files, fix-commit diffs fetched from the network, CVE descriptions, or the in-tree vulnerability reports (GANGA-VULNERABILITY-REPORT.md etc.) were opened; the fix's code_before/code_after quoted in the prompt were compared against the already-read DB source only.
